text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the Official Plan Amendment, Zoning By-law Amendment, and Draft Plan of Subdivision applications located at 1799 St. Clair Avenue West. The applications propose the conversion of lands designated General Employment Areas to Mixed Use Areas to permit three mixed-use towers with heights of 30,40, and 45-storeys, inclusive of base buildings that would range in height from three to eight-storeys. The proposed redevelopment proposes 1,151 residential units and an approximate total gross floor area (GFA) of 108,063 square metres, inclusive of 11,025 square metres of non-residential GFA. The applications propose a privately-owned public space (POPS), the dedication of land towards the future extension of Davenport Road, and a network of public and private lanes. Staff are currently reviewing the applications.…
